content:
I’m excited to share that I’ve joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!

I’ve been working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, and it’s been incredibly rewarding to see how it has evolved and how teams are using it to bring more actionable, context-aware clinical decision support into healthcare workflows.

I’m looking forward to helping move the standard forward alongside the broader CDS Hooks community.

If your organization is already using CDS Hooks, please consider adding your implementation to the CDS Hooks Availability wiki so others can learn from the growing ecosystem:  
https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

And if you’re not using CDS Hooks yet but are interested in implementing it, I’m available as a freelance consultant and would be happy to help you get started.

#CDSHooks #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthIT #FHIR #Interoperability
